# Hash-pinned build tools for the Flatpak dependency generator.
#
# WHY THIS FILE EXISTS
# --------------------
# The `generate` job in .github/workflows/flatpak.yml used to run
#
#     python3 -m pip install --quiet --upgrade uv req2flatpak
#
# and then used those two tools to write `packaging/flatpak/python3-yazses.json`
# -- the list of 45 wheels, each with a URL and a hash, that Flathub builds the
# app from.
#
# That is the pin problem inverted. The whole value of the generated file is that
# it pins; the program that decides what those pins ARE was installed from
# whatever PyPI served that minute, with `--upgrade` to make sure it was the very
# newest. A compromised `req2flatpak` writes attacker URLs and matching hashes
# into a file a human then reviews as "45 pinned wheels" -- and hashes are
# precisely what a reviewer does not re-derive by hand.
#
# So the generator's own inputs are hash-pinned here, and installed with
# `--require-hashes`, which makes pip refuse anything whose artifact does not
# match. The closure is four packages, so this costs almost nothing to carry.
#
# `packaging==21.3` is old, and it is not a mistake: req2flatpak 0.3.1 declares
# `packaging<22.0,>=21.3`, and `pyparsing` is here only because packaging 21.x
# still needed it. Nothing from this file is shipped -- these run on a CI runner
# to produce a JSON file and are then discarded.
#
# TO REGENERATE (after changing the two tool names above, or to take newer
# versions deliberately):
#
#     printf 'uv\nreq2flatpak\n' > /tmp/tools.in
#     uv pip compile --generate-hashes --python-version 3.12 \
#       --python-platform x86_64-manylinux2014 \
#       /tmp/tools.in -o packaging/flatpak/tools-requirements.txt
#
# then restore this comment block, which `uv pip compile` does not preserve.
packaging==21.3 \
    --hash=sha256:dd47c42927d89ab911e606518907cc2d3a1f38bbd026385970643f9c5b8ecfeb \
    --hash=sha256:ef103e05f519cdc783ae24ea4e2e0f508a9c99b2d4969652eed6a2e1ea5bd522
    # via req2flatpak
pyparsing==3.3.2 \
    --hash=sha256:850ba148bd908d7e2411587e247a1e4f0327839c40e2e5e6d05a007ecc69911d \
    --hash=sha256:c777f4d763f140633dcb6d8a3eda953bf7a214dc4eff598413c070bcdc117cbc
    # via packaging
req2flatpak==0.3.1 \
    --hash=sha256:1fc26c00d38d2b1c49115a764ab7decd69971fa7820548a0a232581643376a3c \
    --hash=sha256:528bd91151222ae9be3d293002fb04d7885db4628bdedc592473da1f364423e2
    # via the tool list above
uv==0.12.7 \

    --hash=sha256:3ac3321ccd6097dbef154d27044e0762a67b2f6eb017dcc65be6574f4671fb0d \
    --hash=sha256:4545e87c7ac64af317d8daffd279e23e93b0e05035662363033d3525923339d2 \
